articles.title: Rajasthan: Two Women Dies After Cesarean Deliveries At New Medical College Hospital In Kota - TimelineDaily
articles.full_text:
Kota, Rajasthan: Two back to back fatalities were reported, both following Cesarean deliveries at the New Medical College Hospital in Rajasthan’s Kota in 24 hours. Both the women reportedly developed kidney-related complications following the C-section raising fresh concerns about post-delivery care in the state hospital.
Notably, a similar incident had occurred at the same hospital nearly five months ago, when 12 new mothers reportedly developed kidney failure following Cesarean deliveries, resulting in five deaths. The recurrence of such incidents have raise questions about the hospital’s treatment protocols.

articles.title: Security Tightened Outside Salman Khans Galaxy Apartments After Tiger Shroff Firing Incident; Police Check - Free Press Journal
articles.full_text:
Security has been tightened outside Salman Khan's residence Galaxy Apartments in Mumbai following the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff. Police personnel have increased checks in the area and are inspecting vehicles near the actor's home as a precautionary measure.
The development comes amid the ongoing investigation into the firing outside a football ground in Juhu, where Tiger was present on Sunday (October 18).
The incident has also drawn attention to an earlier warning mentioned in a voice note that surfaced on social media, allegedly linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang and referring to Tiger's association with Salman Khan.
Meanwhile, all three accused in the Tiger Shroff firing case have been arrested in Kota, Rajasthan. The Anti-Gangster Task Force, along with Rajasthan Police, apprehended them at Kota railway station while they were travelling from Mumbai to Delhi.
According to reports, the accused had reached Kota by train and were caught at the railway station. The group includes one person from Maharashtra and two from Haryana. They had allegedly been absconding since the firing incident.
Although the actor reportedly escaped serious injury, his driver was shot and taken to the hospital for treatment.
Lawrence Bishnoi gang takes responsibility
A social media post circulating from a Facebook account bearing the name ‘Anmol Bishnoi’ purportedly carries a message claiming responsibility for the attack. The message names Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu as those allegedly taking responsibility on behalf of the gang.
In the post, the purported authors claim they had previously contacted Shroff to warn him but allege that he did not heed the warning. The message also threatens members of the Mumbai film industry who do not comply with the gang’s demands or continue working with Salman Khan, warning that they could be targeted next.
The post concludes with a threatening message asking the film industry to wait and watch. The authenticity of the social media claim and the identities of those behind the firing remain subject to police verification.
Attack outside Salman Khan's residence
On April 14, 2024, at around 4.45 am, two men arrived on a motorbike and fired five rounds outside Khan's Galaxy Apartment in Bandra. The five accused who are to face trial in the case are Vickykumar Gupta, Sagarkumar Pal, Sonukumar Bishnoi, Rafiq Choudhari and Harpal Hardeep Singh.
The three accused, namely Lawrence Bishnoi, Anmol Bishnoi and Ravtaram Swami alias Rohit Godara, have been shown as wanted accused in the case.

articles.title: Mika Singh Questions Mumbais Safety After Tiger Shroff Firing Incident, Demands Strict Action: No One Should - Free Press Journal
articles.full_text:
Singer Mika Singh expressed concern over public safety in Mumbai following the firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff. Calling for stricter action from the government and the authorities, Mika said the incident has raised questions about the safety of people in a city long considered one of India's safest.
For those unversed, the firing took place in Mumbai's Juhu area on October 18. Three men were involved in the incident and they have been nabbed in Kota, Rajasthan. Tiger reportedly escaped without bullet injuries, while his driver and a bystander were injured.
On Monday, Mika wished the actor a speedy recovery and urged the authorities to take the matter seriously, stressing that no citizen should have to live in fear.
Mika Singh shares video on Instagram
Mika shared a video on Instagram in which he spoke about the incident and recalled arriving in Mumbai in the early 2000s. At the time, he believed the city was among the safest places in the world.
Expressing concern that such an incident occurred during the festive season, the singer said, “To have this happen to Tiger, especially during the festive season, I believe the government should take strict action. What happened to Tiger today can happen to anyone tomorrow,”
In the accompanying caption, Mika highlighted Mumbai's reputation for allowing people, particularly women, to travel and go about their daily lives without fear, even late at night.
“Mumbai has always been known as one of the safest cities in India, where people—especially women—have felt confident walking, working, and travelling even late at night. But after the incident involving Tiger Shroff, it raises serious concerns about our safety. No one should have to live in fear on the streets of our own city.”
The singer also called for stronger measures to prevent such incidents and ensure public safety. His caption further stated, “I sincerely request the government and the concerned authorities to take this matter seriously and ensure the safety of every citizen. We need stronger action and accountability so that Mumbai continues to be a city where everyone feels safe, day or night,”
Lawrence Bishnoi Associates Claim Responsibility for Firing
Meanwhile, social media posts attributed to Lawrence Bishnoi associates Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu reportedly claimed responsibility for the firing incident. The post also issued a warning to people in the Mumbai film industry who work with Salman Khan.
The message, written in Hindi, stated, “We had called him and tried to explain things to him, but he did not understand. So today, we made sure to explain it to him properly,”
It further warned, “Anyone in the Mumbai film industry who does not listen to us or works with Salman Khan will be next. Wait and watch.”
The claims have added another dimension to the investigation. However, the allegations and the circumstances surrounding the incident remain subject to police investigation.
Three Suspects Detained at Kota Railway Station
In a development in the case, three suspects were detained at Kota railway station on Monday morning while travelling on a train from Mumbai to Delhi. The case has since been handed over to Mumbai Police for further investigation.
Further interrogation is expected to help investigators establish the suspects' alleged roles and the circumstances leading up to the firing.
